title: The End of the Aisle
cn: 第 22 集 · 走廊尽头
novel:
As the wedding ceremony approached, both Barney and Robin experienced severe [[panic|panic]] attacks. Robin sat in her dressing room, [[trembling|tremble]] with [[fear|fear]]. She was not sure she could go through with it. What if she was making the biggest [[mistake|mistake]] of her life?

Barney was equally [[terrified|terrify]]. He paced back and forth in his room, unable to put on his tie. He kept thinking about all the ways the marriage could fail. Ted found him and tried to [[encourage|encourage]] him.

Ted told Barney that being [[scared|scared]] was normal. He said that the best things in life often required [[courage|courage]]. Barney listened and slowly began to calm down. He put on his tie and looked at himself in the mirror. He saw a man who was ready to make a [[commitment|commitment]].

Meanwhile, Marshall and Lily decided to [[rewrite|rewrite]] their own wedding [[vows|vow]]. They had been married for years, but the events of the weekend made them realize they wanted to express their love in a new way. They sat together and wrote [[heartfelt|heartfelt]] promises to each other.

Marshall told Lily that she was his best friend and the love of his life. Lily told Marshall that he was the most [[devoted|devote]] father and husband she had ever known. They were both moved to tears.

Robin finally found her courage. She walked out of her dressing room and stood at the end of the [[aisle|aisle]]. Barney stood at the other end, waiting for her. When their eyes met, all the fear disappeared. They knew they were making the right choice.

The ceremony began as the sun set over the ocean. The gang watched with tears in their eyes as Barney and Robin exchanged their vows. It was the [[beginning|beginning]] of a new [[chapter|chapter]] for all of them.

encourage.en: She encouraged him to try again.

scared.en: He was scared of the dark.

beginning.en: It was the beginning of a new life.

chapter.en: This is a new chapter in her life.
